senses.gloss:
ए The eleventh vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to the letter E
as pronounced in most languages except the English, and having
the sound of A in amiable.

ए ind. An interjection of, 1. Remembering, (ha.)
 2. Censure or con-
tempt.
 3. Compassion, (ah!)
 4. Addressing, (eh! hey.)
 5. Calling,
(hey, ho.)
ए m. (-एः) A name of VIṢṆU.
